C9000173.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 173 (Seymour’s second-neighborhood conjecture.; papers: A proof of Seymour’s second-neighborhood conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/173.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PRUNING.statement: For every finite binary relation and separate pair families R,C, there is conflict-free pruning retaining every initially conflict-free member and deleting at most |H| plus the number of subsequently uncovered points of Z.

C_COEFFICIENTS.statement: The fixed positive integer entry for arrow e, 2^(2^e), simultaneously realizes every structural submatrix rank needed for L,N and all D^{p,i}; the two arrays may be chosen equal.

C_KERNEL_CORE.statement: Maximum support rank implies the conflict-kernel identity after restriction; this identity makes the matched-endpoint kernel lifts have independent B-images in ker A.

C_AUGMENTED_BOUND.statement: Every augmented matching has size at most |Z|+|H|, using a maximum matching minimizing original-original edges and the certified kernel core.

C_COVER_PRUNING.statement: An alternating-path minimum vertex cover omitting isolated vertices gives the full deletion cost and retains initially conflict-free members.

M_SUBSET_DEFICIT.statement: An order-minimal then arc-minimal counterexample satisfies |F^2(S)\F(S)|<|F(S)\S| for every nonempty proper S.

M_BLOWUP.statement: A transitive-tournament blowup with block size m>|V(D)| amplifies subset deficit to strict subset concavity.

M_REDUCTION.statement: A counterexample to Seymour's conjecture yields an oriented graph with positive indegrees and strict subset concavity.

M_INCOMPATIBILITY.statement: No nonempty finite oriented graph with positive indegrees has strict subset concavity.

M_MAIN.statement: Every nonempty finite oriented graph has a vertex with at least as many exact second out-neighbors as first out-neighbors.
